raw:
The user wants onboarding copy for a Traditional Chinese expense-tracking app. Three pages, each with a title (t) and one subtitle (b). Last page has a CTA button "開始使用" (start using).

Rules:
- No chatty phrasing as buttons/titles/status
- No casual variants of 取消/完成
- No apologies, no exclamation marks in errors
- No questions as buttons or titles
- No explaining how numbers computed, no disclaimers
- No describing unseen stuff
- Numbers already estimated: no 約/大概 (n/a here)
- No 我們; avoid 你的/您的 unless needed
- Don't repeat title in subtitle; don't explain obvious things
- No PRC terms: 當前、默認、設置、數據、視頻、用戶、緩存、軟件、網絡、信息
- No periods at end of labels/buttons
- Keep it short

Page 1: 銀行帳戶連結,自動匯入交易
Page 2: 自動分類支出
Page 3: 每月預算提醒, CTA 開始使用

Draft:

t1: 連結銀行帳戶
b1: 自動匯入交易紀錄

t2: 支出自動分類
b2: 交易依類別歸位,無需手動整理 — hmm "無需手動整理" might be explaining. Keep it simple: 每筆交易自動歸入類別

Wait — avoid "資料"? 資料 is fine in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage). 數據 is banned; 資料 is the Taiwan term.

t3: 每月預算提醒
b3: 接近上限時通知 — hmm. "預算即將到期前發送通知"? Simpler: 超出預算前收到通知. Or 掌握每月預算狀況.

cta: 開始使用

Check subtitle doesn't repeat title. t1 "連結銀行帳戶" b1 "自動匯入交易紀錄" — good, no repetition.

t2 "自動分類支出" b1... b2 should add something: "交易自動歸入飲食、交通等類別" — that uses examples; okay but maybe too long. Keep: b2: "每筆交易自動歸入對應類別". Hmm "對應類別" fine.

t3 "每月預算提醒" b3: "接近預算上限時通知" — that's the reminder content, adds value. Good.

CTA: 開始使用 (no period).

Avoid 你的/我們 — none used.

No PRC terms. 紀錄 vs 記錄: Taiwan often 紀錄 for noun records; both acceptable. Use 交易紀錄.

JSON exactly as requested.{"t1":"連結銀行帳戶","b1":"自動匯入交易紀錄","t2":"支出自動分類","b2":"每筆交易歸入對應類別","t3":"每月預算提醒","b3":"接近預算上限時通知","cta":"開始使用"}

parsed.b2: 每筆交易歸入對應類別
